funding_sources: PARTIAL_SAFU_DEPLOYMENT; EXPECTED OVER THE NEXT 24 HOURS
PORTION_OF_FUTURES_INSURANCE_FUND; BINANCE SAYS REMAINING BALANCE STAYS ABOVE REQUIRED LEVEL
official_update3_claims.company_statement: Binance says it will absorb the financial impact rather than pass it to users.

safu_btc_address_observation.observation: The public explorer capture showed no transaction after 2026-08-09 in this disclosed SAFU BTC address. Binance's update says partial SAFU deployment is expected over the next 24 hours, not that it had already completed at the 17:52 UTC capture.
limitations: This is one publicly identified SAFU BTC address, not a complete map of all SAFU assets, sub-custody or off-chain movements.
A lack of movement in this address does not disprove deployment from another wallet or an internal accounting reallocation.
The explorer is a secondary data provider.

causal_interpretation.confirmed: Binance publicly states that aggregate coverage increased from approximately 80% to 90%, and that the ten named assets including XRP are now 100% backed; it identifies SAFU, futures insurance and corporate treasury as sources.
causal_interpretation.inferred: The October 31 XRP PoR screenshot is consistent with slightly more XRP reserve than net customer liabilities at the snapshot time.
not_established: The exact quantity of XRP bought after the incident.
Whether any XRP was acquired on open spot markets versus OTC or sourced from existing treasury/custody inventory.
The amount of SAFU or futures-insurance capital allocated specifically to XRP.
That the 233.46M XRP stolen from the five source wallets has been recovered from the attacker.
That the 100.99% screenshot is already cryptographically verified; the Merkle root was still in progress.
causal_interpretation.key_distinction: 100% backing of XRP customer liabilities is not the same as recovering stolen XRP, nor does it disclose the marginal purchase flow. The 90% aggregate coverage figure refers to the broader affected-asset set; the remaining 10% is outside the named top ten.
